name: Land
overview: The Bible reveals that land is a divine creation, appearing on the third day as God gathered the waters to let dry land appear, establishing the foundation for human stewardship (Genesis 1:9). God granted humanity dominion over the earth and its creatures, commanding them to be fruitful and multiply upon the land (Genesis 1:28). The promise of land is central to God's covenant with Abram, who was called to leave his country for a land God would show him, with the assurance that all the land he could see would be given to him and his descendants forever (Genesis 12:1; 13:14-15). This highlights the original divine ownership and the special status of the promised land within God’s redemptive plan.
